summary: Fury Gold Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the initiation of environmental baseline studies at its Eau Claire gold project in Quebec. The company engaged Wassah, a Cree-owned environmental firm, to conduct field inventories over two years to establish baseline conditions for a future environmental impact assessment. No financial terms, stakeholder changes, or board actions were disclosed. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing reports ordinary project advancement with no trigger for a special-situations classification.
